summary: Millicom International Cellular S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 20, 2026. Shareholders approved all board proposals, including the re-election of directors, reappointment of KPMG as auditor, approval of annual accounts, and a dividend distribution of USD 3 per share payable in four equal installments. A Share Repurchase Plan was also approved. This is a routine AGM outcome filing with no special-situation event; there are no acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or other extraordinary corporate actions. As a foreign private issuer, the Form 6-K serves as a current report equivalent to a U.S. domestic Form 8-K for such routine matters.
